description: This is a C source file implementing a USB-C sink device application using Zephyr RTOS. It manages port data, builds Request Data Objects (RDO), displays Power Data Objects (PDO), and registers policy callbacks for USB-C behavior.

methods.name: build_rdo
methods.description: Constructs a Request Data Object (RDO) with specific power and capability parameters.

methods.name: display_pdo
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a Power Data Object (PDO) based on its type.

methods.name: display_source_caps
methods.description: Iterates over source capabilities and displays each PDO.

methods.name: port0_policy_cb_get_rdo
methods.description: Callback to get the current Request Data Object.

methods.name: port0_notify
methods.description: Handles notifications from the USB-C policy layer.

methods.name: port0_policy_check
methods.description: Performs policy checks for power and data role swaps.
